verses.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, ouve a minha oração, dá ouvidos às minhas súplicas! Atende-me na tua fidelidade, e na tua retidão;
verses.en_web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> Let my prayer come to you, O Lord; give ear to my requests for your grace; keep faith with me, and give me an answer in your righteousness;

verses.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.pt: e não entres em juízo com o teu servo, porque à tua vista não se achará justo nenhum vivente.
verses.en_web: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Let not your servant come before you to be judged; for no man living is upright in your eyes.

verses.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.pt: Pois o inimigo me perseguiu; abateu-me até o chão; fez-me habitar em lugares escuros, como aqueles que morreram há muito.
verses.en_web: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.en_bbe: The evil man has gone after my soul; my life is crushed down to the earth: he has put me in the dark, like those who have long been dead.

verses.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.pt: Pelo que dentro de mim esmorece o meu espírito, e em mim está desolado o meu coração.
verses.en_web: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this my spirit is overcome; and my heart is full of fear.

verses.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.pt: Lembro-me dos dias antigos; considero todos os teus feitos; medito na obra das tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
verses.en_bbe: I keep in mind the early days of the past, giving thought to all your acts, even to the work of your hands.

verses.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.pt: A ti estendo as minhas mãos; a minha alma, qual terra sedenta, tem sede de ti.
verses.en_web: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: My hands are stretched out to you: my soul is turned to you, like a land in need of water. (Selah.)

verses.en: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.pt: Atende-me depressa, ó Senhor; o meu espírito desfalece; não escondas de mim o teu rosto, para que não me torne semelhante aos que descem à cova.
verses.en_web: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.en_bbe: Be quick in answering me, O Lord, for the strength of my spirit is gone: let me see your face, so that I may not be like those who go down into the underworld.

verses.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.pt: Faze-me ouvir da tua benignidade pela manhã, pois em ti confio; faze-me saber o caminho que devo seguir, porque a ti elevo a minha alma.
verses.en_web: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
verses.en_bbe: Let the story of your mercy come to me in the morning, for my hope is in you: give me knowledge of the way in which I am to go; for my soul is lifted up to you.

verses.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.pt: Livra-me, ó Senhor, dos meus inimigos; porque em ti é que eu me refugio.
verses.en_web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, take me out of the hands of my haters; my soul is waiting for you.

verses.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.pt: Ensina-me a fazer a tua vontade, pois tu és o meu Deus; guie-me o teu bom Espírito por terreno plano.
verses.en_web: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verses.en_bbe: Give me teaching so that I may do your pleasure; for you are my God: let your good Spirit be my guide into the land of righteousness.

verses.en: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.pt: Vivifica-me, ó Senhor, por amor do teu nome; por amor da tua justiça, tira-me da tribulação.
verses.en_web: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: Give me life, O Lord, because of your name; in your righteousness take my soul out of trouble.

verses.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.pt: E por tua benignidade extermina os meus inimigos, e destrói todos os meus adversários, pois eu sou servo.
verses.en_web: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.
verses.en_bbe: And in your mercy put an end to my haters, and send destruction on all those who are against my soul; for I am your servant.
